name: Redemptor Dreadnought

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (W&G, page.133).

abilities.name: Raging Redemption
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +2 bonus die to its attack Test as part of the Charge.

determination: Lightning Reflexes: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
note: Normal threat block, not vehicle format. Printed 'Heavy Bolter ... Ap -1', 'resolve Test' and a double full stop in Furisio (Dreadnought only); Plasma Cannon and Heavy Bolter sit outside the ACTION line in print but are stored with the Claw. Printed Size 'Avg'. Redemptor Dreadnought reprints the Dreadnought with S 10 and Raging Redemption in place of Furisio.
